_comment: Pterodactyl QEMU VM egg. Set the Docker image to wherever you pushed the image.
name: QEMU VM
author: admin@example.com
description: Run a full virtual machine (QEMU/KVM) inside a Pterodactyl server: RAW disk, custom ISO, virtio-9p shared folder, optional guest SSH.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Only creates the persistent directories; the VM is installed on first start.
mkdir -p /mnt/server/iso /mnt/server/shared /mnt/server/config
exit 0

variables.name: OS choice
variables.description: Predefined OS to download: alpine, debian, ubuntu, arch, rocky. Leave empty to use ISO_URL or an uploaded ISO. Convenience only, not an allowlist.

variables.name: Custom ISO URL
variables.description: Direct http(s) link to any .iso. Wins over OS_CHOICE. Only used if the ISO file does not exist yet.

variables.name: ISO file path
variables.description: Where the ISO lives/is saved (inside /home/container). Point it at an ISO you uploaded via the File Manager.

variables.name: ISO file name
variables.description: Optional file name (must end in .iso); overrides ISO_PATH and stores the ISO in /home/container/iso/.

variables.name: ISO SHA-256
variables.description: Optional 64-hex checksum to verify the ISO.

variables.name: VM name
variables.description: Name shown to QEMU (letters, digits, space . _ -).

variables.name: Reserved RAM (MB)
variables.description: Memory kept for QEMU/container overhead. Guest RAM = server memory - this. 256+ is safer.

variables.name: Minimum guest RAM (MB)
variables.description: Refuse to start if the guest would get less than this.

variables.name: CPU cores
variables.description: vCPUs for the guest (clamped to the container CPU limit).

variables.name: Disk size
variables.description: Size of the sparse RAW disk created on first install (e.g. 20G).

variables.name: Disk format
variables.description: Only 'raw' is supported.

variables.name: Auto-expand disk
variables.description: Grow the existing disk to DISK_SIZE at boot if DISK_SIZE is larger (never shrinks).

variables.name: Disk bus
variables.description: virtio (Linux), nvme, or ide (Windows without virtio drivers).

variables.name: Acceleration
variables.description: kvm, tcg (software) or auto.

variables.name: Allow TCG fallback
variables.description: If ACCELERATION=kvm but /dev/kvm is unusable, fall back to slow TCG instead of failing.

variables.name: Boot mode
variables.description: auto, bios or uefi. Pinned on first use; do not change after installing.

variables.name: Install mode
variables.description: auto = install until confirmed; install = force installer boot; installed = declare an existing disk as installed.

variables.name: VNC enabled
variables.description: Graphical console for the installer.

variables.name: VNC port
variables.description: Must be an extra allocation of this server, >= 5900.

variables.name: VNC password
variables.description: Up to 8 characters. Empty = random password printed in the console and saved to config/vnc-password.

variables.name: Enable SSH
variables.description: Forward the primary allocation port to guest TCP 22. The guest must run sshd.

variables.name: SSH user
variables.description: User created by the optional guest provisioning script.

variables.name: SSH public key
variables.description: Public key written to shared/ptero-ssh/authorized_keys for the provisioning script.

variables.name: Primary port (informational)
variables.description: Ignored when Wings supplies SERVER_PORT (it always does). Only a manual fallback for testing.

variables.name: Shared folder tag
variables.description: virtio-9p mount tag.

variables.name: Shared folder read-only
variables.description: Expose the shared folder read-only to the guest.

variables.name: Network model
variables.description: virtio-net-pci, e1000, e1000e or rtl8139.

variables.name: Restrict guest network
variables.description: true = no outbound access for the guest (port forwards still work).

variables.name: Shutdown timeout (s)
variables.description: Seconds to wait for ACPI shutdown before QEMU is told to quit.
